## Changes

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and any remaining limitations.

## Screenshots

For UI changes, include screenshots showing the result. Include before and after
views when they help explain the change, and capture relevant interaction states
(for example, a selection or an expanded menu). Use sample data suitable for sharing.

For changes without a visual effect, write “Not applicable.”

## Stack

If this PR is stacked, link its parent PR and state the intended merge order.
